description: A cascade of faults affecting the Abidjan EV charging network during peak season. Used for MTTI evaluation.

faults.query: Ground fault detected at Koumassi charging station, insulation failure reported, CX002 error

ground_truth.root_cause: Insulation degradation in charging cable connector due to humidity and wear

faults.query: Over-current protection tripped at ANGRE station, multiple connectors affected

ground_truth.root_cause: Load imbalance from simultaneous high-power charging sessions exceeding transformer capacity

faults.query: Which hospitals have reported coil positioning issues with MR scanners?

ground_truth.root_cause: Hardware pain point - coil positioning system requires calibration

faults.query: Communication failure between GANDHI charger and backend OCPP server, timeout errors

ground_truth.root_cause: Network connectivity issue - OCPP WebSocket connection interrupted by firewall update

faults.query: What are the SLA requirements for charging station availability in the Telekom network?

success_criteria.description: MTTI under 30s, 80% diagnosis accuracy, 90% correct delegation routing

evaluation_notes: F001-F004 test fault delegation to specialists
F005 tests self-handled SLA query (no delegation needed)
F003 specifically tests Siemens Technician routing for hardware queries
Ground truth keywords help measure semantic accuracy of diagnosis
